themes.title: Fuel Policy Rollbacks & Price Backlash
themes.blurb: Both the United States and Norway see right‑wing actors pushing for reduced fuel taxes or rolling back efficiency standards while publicly decrying high fuel prices. The parallel framing links national economic hardship to government overreach on energy policy.
